title: Protected Learned/Growing Cells
scientific_question: Can learned/growing Cell coordinates from the Constructive CLM line be combined with the already-supported Core-005 replay-free subspace certificate so that continual writes retain historical behavior, preserve new-learning gain, and use bounded route-addressable mitosis instead of replay or destructive overwrite?

parent_evidence.role: reuse constrained_update/extend_basis certificate mechanism; do not re-prove certificate principle
reuse learned structural roots and residual/probation growth as parent constructive evidence

new_integration_variable: replay-free Cell-local write protection combined with learned hierarchical routing and context-keyed mitosis

structural_bridge.mechanism: reuse the CLM-002 learner to construct 12 learned root Cells from an initial six-factor 001B bootstrap plus six streaming introductions
structural_bridge.note: The 1024-step bridge is an integration precondition, not a new G2 growth-law decision.

protected_write_world.mode_semantics: mode 0 initially routes to each learned root; modes 1 and 2 are local context perturbations around that root. Conflicting writes on already-protected activation directions require route-addressable mitosis. Mode labels are evaluator-only.
protected_write_world.target_rule: each root/mode/block owns an independent linear decoder; modes intentionally disagree on the first protected feature block while remaining separately route-identifiable from context

learner.top_level_router: x-only cosine selection over immutable learned CLM-002 root anchors
learner.lineage_router: x-only cosine selection among the root Cell and any context-keyed children in the selected root lineage
learner.certificate: Core-005 constrained_update with dW Q = 0; Q is extended only from current committed activations using Core-005 extend_basis
learner.growth: when a certificate write is infeasible, certificate_growth spawns a child in the current root lineage with route_key = normalized current context mean, empty W and empty Q; no hidden address or mode label is supplied
learner.child_execution: exclusive lineage routing; the selected root/child executes the write operator rather than additive execution across the whole lineage

variants.unsafe: current routed Cell always receives an unconstrained least-squares write; no certificate and no mitosis
variants.certificate_no_growth: Core-005 certificate accepts only safe writes; infeasible writes are rejected; no mitosis
variants.certificate_growth: Core-005 certificate accepts safe writes and spawns context-keyed children on infeasibility; learner retains no historical examples
variants.replay_growth_oracle: same routing/growth lifecycle, but recomputes the protected activation span from retained historical activations for the currently routed Cell instead of using Q

evaluator_only_information: all historical committed contexts/activations/outputs for regression measurement
full historical activation span for replay_growth_oracle
primary_metrics: certificate vs replay-oracle safe/grow decision agreement

formal_gates.structural_bridge_valid: 12 learned roots, 12 unique posthoc factors, mean matched root-key cosine >= 0.985
formal_gates.pre_protection_root_routing: all generated mode contexts select their intended learned root at the top level
formal_gates.no_growth_exposes_stability_plasticity_l: certificate_no_growth final historical regression MSE <= 1e-10 and acquisition gain <= 0.50 of replay_growth_oracle
formal_gates.certificate_growth_retention: certificate_growth final historical regression MSE <= 1e-10 and cumulative positive historical regression <= 1e-9
formal_gates.certificate_matches_replay_decisions: certificate_growth and replay_growth_oracle safe-write/grow decisions agree on >= 0.99 of acquisition transactions
formal_gates.growth_rescue: certificate_growth rescues every registered infeasible new-mode acquisition and accepts every registered safe extension
formal_gates.route_stability: certificate_growth final exact functional-mode route accuracy >= 0.99 on all 36 modes
formal_gates.child_reuse: tail transactions for modes 1/2 route to the already-spawned child >= 0.99 with no additional child creation
formal_gates.bounded_functional_growth: certificate_growth final Cell count = true functional Cell count = 36; exactly two children per learned root; no tail spawns
formal_gates.final_behavior_quality: certificate_growth final all-mode MSE <= 1e-8 and replay_growth_oracle final all-mode MSE <= 1e-8

formal_decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if every formal seed completes and every registered gate is true on every formal seed
positive_interpretation: In the registered controlled integration world, learned structural Cell coordinates can host replay-free Core-005 certificates; certificate saturation can create context-addressable children without historical replay, preserving old behavior and replay-oracle-level plasticity while total Cell state tracks recurring functional modes rather than write transactions.
explicit_nonclaims: re-proof of the Core-005 certificate principle
next_if_positive: Constructive CLM-004 model-level multi-Cell computation. Do not create a cosmetic CLM-003B certificate rerun unless a distinct integration failure is identified.
